name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. /kingdom:work runs the full daily cycle in one command. v0.31.1 fixes two consumer-reported bugs (claude REPL not auto-launching on worker spawn; King's poll loop calling a stale-named overlay function via the silent-no-op bash-function-missing path), adds R45 (Haiku-army doc orientation for all roles), watchman senior-dev review with doc cross-check, mandatory worker smoke-test reports, and Sonnet default for the sub-agent pool. v0.31.0 hardened R4/R9/R30/R36/R37 with bash-level gate helpers. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace. Kingdom branch is a WORKING-TREE OVERLAY for review (never commit on kingdom). PRs carve from worker-N tip byte-for-byte. Two-tier gate. Domain-agnostic. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; run the day with /kingdom:work; close with /kingdom:save. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
